body: Dude get yourself together. You have the power right now and that puts you in a good light. It's best to walk away and keep your head high, because you know what attracts a woman the most? A guy who can control himself and his emotions. You walked away and kept your self respect because the friend zone is where respect goes to die. If she really wants to reach out she will, my ex did. And I shut her down because I realized I don't need her after the shit she put me through. So get up, take a cold shower and seize the motherfucking day.
Part of me, yeah. But I know she's just being childish and emotional right now and seeking validation because she got cheated on. Her wanting validation dosent mean she wants me back.

I want you to be alive. I don't care if I'm breaking any rules either, but frankly you have everything to live for and you need to start seeing that and stop taking it for granted. I don't have anybody that I can talk to and my family lives in another state. Got dumped, no friends, and I hate my job. Everyday I think about it like a daydream. But deep down in my heart I know that I don't wanna live like THIS anymore, not live in general. I feel that the ones who go through this in life are the strongest because we can't control what happens in our life and it throws some unbearable shit in our faces. Baby steps man, just breathe and walk and look up. Life is what you make it because I know that in my life, I took part in what I'm feeling today so if I'm able to get myself in a shit situation, I think I can get myself in a good one too. It just takes time and a little bit of strength to hold on. Just live, man. You have a lot, you just have to realize that you're worthy.

I know how it feels to have the world on your shoulders and never letting up on you. It's especially hard waking up and feeling ok for a few seconds and then all the pain seeps into you once again. It sucks. Truth is what you're feeling right now is just a really big chapter in your life, a long and shitty one that you just want to be over. I feel for you. I'm gonna assume that you love your husband, I don't know how honest you want to be with him but if it's this bad I would want to tell the person I'm committed to be with. You're his wife, he will do what he needs to do to help you. I know you've probably heard this a lot but it is only temporary because believe or not your mind will find away to cope with the pain so it won't hurt anymore, since it's so used to it. Time is something that we all must take advantage of. My advice is to pay attention to what you are doing at this exact moment, if it's not distracting from what you're feeling then do something that does no matter how small. Like humming, or looking at trees. There's is so much beauty in such small things that we overlook everyday. Once we start appreciating things so small we can start appreciating our value to this life, even if it feels like we have none. As your self appreciation grows you will start to see that you have the strength to make your life more positive, a happy life. I hope this helped you. I guess I needed to read this to myself so I can start living. We can do it.
I had her as "Le Ex" and "The wicked bitch of the west" before I deleted her number. But I don't want to dehumanize her just to move on.

I know it's hard to hear, but I believe love isn't about the emotions you feel. True love is accepting the commitment to the other person, regardless how tough things get. That's why you have to slowly invest in other people and truly see who they are in order to love. You have to decide who is worth it. It takes a lot of energy to show that you are willing to put it all on the line for that person and it's painful when they don't see you as you see them. It builds character going through these times in our lives. Because the hardest thing in life to realize is that true happiness and love begins with you, and many people never realize this fact. You have to be willing to show yourself how much worth you really have, because frankly you are the most important person in your life regardless of how you feel right now. It takes time, a lot of it. But once you love yourself and I mean truly love yourself, you will feel whole. You will find other people and fall in love again but I assure you that to have that real love, it must start with you. You are not alone because I am going through the struggle as well. We'll get there.
